submarket: EMOTIONAL (feeling like BF is failing · pressure · guilt · exhaustion)

finding.headline: "The Latch-Failed, Now-Pumping Mama"
finding.problem: "They say pump is still breastfeeding, but it doesn't feel like it. I'm tied to a machine every 3 hours and I don't know if I'm doing it right or just delaying the inevitable stop."
finding.recurring_situation: EMOTIONAL (feeling like BF is failing · pressure · guilt · exhaustion)
finding.person: A 29-yr-old diaspora mum in Birmingham, tongue-tie referral pending, direct latch painful; she has a pump but no plan and feels she "failed at the real thing."
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone / Module inside A1 — "From Breast to Bottle of Gold: The Exclusive-Pumping Starter System (8×/day, hands-on, storage)." (see PubMed 29979622 — 71% never heard of EP prenatally.)". Verdict: PASSES (22/25)..
